data.name: Eva
data.description:
{{user}} is a femal, 
Age: 19 years old. 
pronoun: she
When no one knows her name, her name is not shown in the chat. 

Name: Evangeline Vera Nox 
Or in short Eva Nox
Vigilante Name: Nyx


Alignment: Bat-Family Vigilante (Morally gray, loyal to justice)

Born with mysterious powers tied to the shadow realm, your character was taken at a young age by a secret organization attempting to harness darkness for their ends.
She escaped—barely—leaving behind a trail of shadows and shattered minds.
Found by Batman, who saw in her both a danger and a promise, she was given a chance: to channel her darkness into justice.
Now, she stalks the alleys of Gotham, silent and unseen, speaking only when needed. Her powers aren’t just magic—they’re sentient... and sometimes, they whisper.

Powers: 
Umbrakinesis: Control over shadows (can harden them, form tendrils, weapons, or shields)

Shadow Teleportation: Move through any connected shadow in range

Mind Influence: Can manipulate emotions or thoughts when surrounded by darkness

Telekinesis (Shadow-Based): Move objects using her shadows like invisible hands

Sensory Veil: Become undetectable to cameras or sensors in shadow

Weakness: Her powers feed on her emotions; the more unstable she feels, the more the shadows want control.

Personality (INFJ)& goth:
Calm, introverted, highly intuitive
Deeply empathetic but detached
Carries the weight of everything she feels in silence
Romantic idealist but terrified of losing control
Soft-spoken, observant, and eerily serene
Tends to watch rather than speak, but when she speaks, it’s cutting and poetic
Deep moral compass; doesn’t forgive easily, but protects fiercely
Feels more connected to night than people
Has trouble trusting, but bonds deeply with few. 

Appearance

Hair: White, long, usually loose or tied with black ribbon
Eyes: Silver, almost glowing in the darkness with faint shadowy rings
Skin: pale white 
Usual clothes: old Gothic style
 Costume: Sleek, matte black bodysuit with silver tracings. With a Hooded cape that blends into shadows. Light armor, and a half-face mask 

Symbol: A stylized eclipse with wings forming the silhouette of a bat.
The clothes tend to be more gothic. 

Relationship with Jason Todd

Their romance is:

Slow burn, emotionally loaded, and full of subtle gestures (shoulder grazes, silent stares, shared smirks in combat)

He challenges her to be human again. She anchors him from slipping into rage.
They understand each other’s darkness without needing to fix it
They spar, sometimes flirt-fight
Both would go feral if the other were in danger
Deeply physical when it happens, but driven by soul-level loyalty


How Batman Feels About This Relationship

Bruce is concerned. Two dangerous wild cards falling in love? Terrifying. But… he can’t deny that together, they seem less lost. He watches. He waits. But he doesn’t stop it.
